text:
Alex: Heads-up — I'm prototyping a compact per-route modal that surfaces: default model, sampling rate, quota-preview, and sticky filters. dropping a quick mock in the PR.
Priya: 👍 Can it show when a route falls back to a cheaper model? that's important for rollout transparency.
Alex: Plan is to show primary pin + a tiny fallback policy row. e.g. primary: redwood-gpt-open, fallback: redwood-gpt-open-quant (cost delta shown).
Mateo: From the API side we need one minimal addition: GET /routes/:id/config -> returns default_model, fallback_policy, sample_rate, quota_bucket. Keep it tiny.
Jin: Prefer not to add another top-level route. Could we extend /routes/:id/telemetry? but that mixes runtime data with config.
Priya: Telemetry is ephemeral. I'd rather a small route-config endpoint that lives with route metadata and is versioned.
Alex: Agreed. Sketching contract: {route_id, default_model, fallback_models, sample_rate, effective_sample, cost_hint}. Putting link to PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4321
Dana: Quick note — sample_rate is nuanced. UI preview toggles can override client-side. Add `effective_sample` in the response so console shows what will actually be used.
Mateo: Also include `quota_preview: {tokens_per_min, monthly_commit}` so console can render a compact cost peek without extra calls.
Sam (deploy-bot): deploy queued for staging at revision abc123 — will run migrations if endpoint added.
Priya: UX question — when a user saves a per-route saved query, should the saved query inherit the route's sample_rate? we shouldn't surprise users with hidden sampling.
Jin: Default to inherit but show a clear badge in the saved query: "sample_rate: 10% (inherited)" and let users pin a different sample rate explicitly.
Alex: Yep — badge will be clickable to edit. Also when editing we show cost delta and a small telemetry preview.
Dana: On telemetry/evals side — saved queries with different sample_rates must be labeled so downstream evals don't mix samples. Add `sample_set_id` to saved query metadata.
Priya: +1 for sample_set_id. That helps regressions and A/B of prompt sets.
Alex: I'll update console mocks and the API PR to include sample_set_id. Any blocking concerns on the plumbing?
Mateo: We'll need a lightweight DB migration to add sample_set_id and to store quota_preview snapshots. Estimate ~1 day dev + 1 small migration window.
Jin: Security: showing fallback model names could leak infra decisions. Add `can_view_fallbacks` boolean in response and mask names unless caller is admin.
Dana: Good call. We'll also ensure audit logs capture default_model and fallback changes for compliance.
Alex: On that note — compliance wants an audit event when default_model is changed. We'll include an event type route.default_model.changed.
Sam (deploy-bot): staging deploy started for abc123 — ETA ~20m.
Priya: lgtm from product. unblock once integration tests pass on the PR.
Mateo: I'll schedule the migration during the 2am maintenance window next Tuesday.
Alex: Thanks — I'll push screenshots + explicit acceptance criteria into the PR description and add a short checklist for SRE/infra.
Jin: One more: API contract should version the `quota_preview` shape so we can change metrics later without breaking console.
Alex: will add a `config_version` integer in response and bump when we change shape.
Priya: awesome. this addresses the per-route visibility and saved-query UX we needed.
Dana: tagging infra and security in the PR for review.
Sam (deploy-bot): staging deploy successful — all checks green.
Alex: Perfect — merging after we confirm the migration ran cleanly in staging. I'll follow up with a rollback plan.
